title: PlayerGuns - On-Foot Weapons (MP Compatible)
tag_line: Camera-aimed FPS guns for BeamNG Walking Mode, with BeamMP sync
author: schatz.r
message:
PlayerGuns adds FPS-style on-foot weapons usable in BeamNG Walking Mode, with BeamMP aim/fire sync.

Default controls: LMB = Fire, Q = Reload, O = Prev Weapon, P = Next Weapon.

Tab-safe controls: use the 'Player Guns Controls' UI app (Ctrl+U) to rebind; bindings persist when switching snowmen. Global input actions replace the old per-unicycle vehicle maps.

Equip: Parts Manager on unicycle > PlayerGuns Armed body > Weapon > Ammo.

UI apps: Player Guns Crosshair, Player Guns Ammo, Player Guns Controls.

Credits: AwesomeCarl & AgentY (player_weapon_2), stefan750 (UniversalWeapons input pattern), Darthbob555 (UI app format).
